actual_tool_job.prompt:
Use case: compositing. Create one high-resolution portrait-card fusion using exactly two inputs. Image1 is the sole authority for clothing, pose, hair, expression, light, and crop. Image2 provides only the mascot identity and anatomy. Transform the human anatomy into a smooth golden-yellow compact near-round mascot head and body with green-ringed black eyes and a source-matching mouth. Preserve the actual short silver-grey hair combed back from a receding hairline, dark grey brows, smooth upper lip and chin with no separate moustache or beard, and no glasses. Maintain the serious closed mouth and original head roll. Keep the dark navy naval overcoat with open neck and lapels over a white-grey shirt collar and narrow dark necktie visible beside the note. Ensure the rounded chin immediately meets the raised and broadened existing neckline with a very short broad neck transition and minimal throat exposure. Avoid any separate yellow neck shaft, pointed V funnel, pinched collar, neck rolls, floating collar, clipping, or cream belly bib. Preserve the actual open naval outer garment with coherent front and rear collar overlap and contact shadow. Retain the complete tilted dark frame, opaque photographic backing in its exact original color, and the attached lower-right cream note with faint indistinct upper marks and actual overlap. All solid surfaces must remain opaque with alpha only outside the complete card silhouette. Do not invent insignia, text, or accessories. Keep fine primary details understated and indistinct.
FINAL EXACT SOURCE REQUIREMENT: Bareheaded near-frontal/mild IMAGE-LEFT angle, short SILVER/GREY hair combed back from a receding hairline, actual grey/dark brow HAIR, smooth upper lip/chin with no separate moustache or beard, no glasses. Serious CLOSED mouth and original head roll. DARK NAVY naval overcoat/jacket with actual OPEN neck/lapels over WHITE/GREY shirt collar and narrow DARK necktie visible beside note. Keep source-exposed collar folds, no invented cap, medals or shoulder orders hidden outside crop.
Retain exact primary head angle, expression, cap shape, real hair and visible clothing/decoration areas. One compact near-round yellow mascot head with a clearly ROUNDED short chin immediately contacting raised broad collar, no V-shaped lower-face funnel or yellow shaft. Preserve actual dark solid cloth and photographic backing opacity. Tiny ambiguous features remain understated; no new badge engraving or decorations hidden behind note. Image1 exact original card; Image2 mascot identity/anatomy only.
Output alpha: genuine transparent RGBA ONLY OUTSIDE the complete original framed portrait silhouette. The photographic BACKING INSIDE the frame is a required OPAQUE surface: preserve its original background color and texture behind the character all the way to the inner frame rim. Never turn the gaps between frame and character into transparent holes or a window. Keep the actual frame angle and rim. Preserve an overlapping paper note, pin or other attachment ONLY when actually visible in this exact source; otherwise do not invent one. Do not invent a new backdrop outside the whole card. Retain source clothing, hair, headgear, lighting and crop at full generated resolution. All originally OPAQUE subject surfaces must remain FULLY OPAQUE (alpha 255): yellow head/body, hair, beard, dark or black clothing, coat lapels, collar, tie, buttons and decorations. Dark cloth is colored material, not transparent background. Never fade garment interiors into semi-transparent patches, holes, white haze or see-through fabric. Keep any genuine source outer-edge alpha falloff only at that actual exterior boundary; preserve actual source transparency rather than making the subject itself translucent.
